summary: Queues an asynchronous procedure call: QueueUserAPC(pfnAPC, dwData[1], (ULONG_PTR)dwData). The thread handle is read from this+0x4, the APC routine is the global pfnAPC (0x0041A160), and the ULONG_PTR APC parameter is the dwData pointer itself. Returns the QueueUserAPC result. No guards.

operations.description: Call QueueUserAPC(pfnAPC, dwData[1], (ULONG_PTR)dwData): queue the global APC routine on the thread identified by the handle at this+0x4, passing this (dwData) as the ULONG_PTR APC parameter.
Return the DWORD result of QueueUserAPC.

unresolved: The identity and semantics of the global APC routine pfnAPC (0x0041A160) are unknown.
The second parameter a2 is unused in the body; its role is unknown.
Whether dwData[0] (this) is a distinct APC-parameter object and what it represents is unverified.
